hooks._note: v0.5.0+ — refresh the last_task_id pointer whenever the host sets a current task. Stop will read this file to know which task to checkpoint.

hooks.command: agent-compass feedback add --signal $TOOL_RESULT --label neutral --notes "auto from hook"
hooks._note: v0.5.0+ — async by default. The call appends to ~/.claude/state/feedback_pending.jsonl and returns 0 immediately. A 'feedback flush' (run from a low-frequency Stop hook or cron) persists the queue.

v0.5.0+ — --unspecified resolves task_id from the state file written by UserPromptSubmit, then AGENT_COMPASS_TASK_ID env var, then falls back to 'unspecified' with a stderr warning. Avoids checkpointing the wrong task.
v0.5.0+ — persist any feedback events queued by the async PostToolUse hook. Designed to be cheap; safe to run on every Stop.
